dedupe_keys.name: thailand transportation network data multi modal origin destination matrices across spatial scales

description: This research dataset provides a multimodal intercity public transport network for Thailand at four nested resolutions, from terminal coordinates up to provinces, covering bus, train, ferry and domestic air services. Bus, train and ferry routes and schedules were collected from BusOnlineTicket.co.th in 2024: 7,782 bus routes (126 operators, 438 terminals), 374 train routes (one state operator, 38 stations) and 167 ferry routes (11 operators, 36 ports). Domestic aviation (343 connections between 72 airports and airfields in 49 provinces) was compiled from annual reports of Airports of Thailand and the Department of Airports. All terminals were geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, checked by hand and joined to administrative boundaries of the Royal Thai Survey Department. The files include a terminal reference table, long-form trip records and origin-destination matrices at terminal, sub-district, district and province level, with a data dictionary. Access: free CSV downloads on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, published 2026-08-21. Caveats: schedules come from a ticketing website at one point in time and air routes from annual reports, so frequencies are indicative. It supports multimodal network flow and accessibility analysis, epidemic spread modelling and transport planning, and complements the Thai Ministry of Transport data catalog catalogued here.
